title: Compliance report consolidation scheduler and transport
creator: Marina Gomez
description: Deliver a tenant-aware scheduling and transport layer that consolidates periodic compliance evidence (logs, policy snapshots, audit trails, console screenshots) into signed packages and reliably delivers them to customer endpoints. Packages must support PDF and CSV renderings, delta + full export modes, per-tenant residency routing, and pluggable transport (S3 region delivery, SFTP push, signed email with attachments). The scheduler should support cron-like recurring jobs, timezone-aware windows, ad-hoc exports, and retention-driven purging. Focus is on predictable operation for enterprise customers who require certified delivery and an immutable audit manifest.
acceptance_criteria: Customers can create a scheduled export job in Console with cadence, timezone, format (PDF/CSV/ZIP), and destination (S3/SFTP/email).
Exports include a signed manifest (SHA256 + HSM signature) listing objects, counts, and export parameters.
Per-tenant residency rules route exports to the correct cloud region or on-prem endpoint automatically.
Delivery success/failure is recorded in the audit log and surfaced in the Report Delivery dashboard with duration and bytes.
Retry/backoff policy applied with exponential backoff and jitter; failures trigger alerting per SLA.
Retention settings drive automatic purge of previously generated packages according to tenant policy, with a tombstone record left in the audit ledger.
comments: 2026-02-16 - Scoping: Workshop with Security, Infra, and PM team. Agreement to use signed manifests and HSM-backed keys for high-risk tenants. Action: ENG to prototype signing flow.
2026-02-20 - Design note: Support both full exports and delta exports (changed since last exported timestamp). Delta export format must explicitly indicate base snapshot and include patch metadata.
2026-02-25 - Feedback from Legal: Need deterministic filename scheme and time-of-export UTC timestamp included in manifest for regulatory traceability.
2026-03-01 - Engineering spike complete (PR: github.com/redwood/repo/pull/1124). Prototype can generate ZIP with PDF+CSV renderings and manifests; currently writes to internal S3 bucket only.

2026-03-04 - Security review: Enforce TLS mutual auth for SFTP targets and require signed transport agreements. Security recommends HSM key rotation policy and encryption-at-rest for delivered objects.
2026-03-07 - UX review: Console flow needs a preview step that shows sample package size estimate and cost impact for scheduled cadence. Added to design TODOs.

2026-03-10 - Current status: Scheduler MVP implemented for S3 and email delivery; SFTP connector blocked behind infra cert automation (dependency ENG-2568). QA plan created and test matrix posted to Confluence.
Next steps: unblock SFTP cert automation, add residency routing rules, implement retention purge with tombstones, wire up Report Delivery dashboard metrics.
implementation_notes: API: POST /v1/compliance/exports to create scheduled jobs; supports timezone, cron expression, formats: pdf,csv,zip; destination: s3|sftp|email; encryption: kms-key-id.
Packaging: bundle objects into a ZIP with directory structure /tenant-id/YYYY/MM/DD/{package}. Contains: data.csv, metadata.json (flattened fields), manifest.sha256, signed.manifest.sig (PKI/HSM).
Signing: use HSM-backed key per-organization when available; fallback to platform key with tenant-scoped metadata. Signature format: PKCS#7 detached signature.
Residency: routing table maps tenant.residency -> preferred-region or on-prem endpoint. Runtime resolves destination prior to job execution and fails fast if unavailable.
Delivery: S3 PUT to customer bucket region when allowed; SFTP push using mutual TLS and an ephemeral cert generated by infra automation; email using signed S/MIME where required.
Observability: emit events to tracing service for start/complete/failure, include bytes and object counts. Expose per-job metrics for dashboard: success_rate, avg_delivery_time, median_package_size.
Retry policy: retries=5, backoff=exponential(30s), jitter, escalate to PagerDuty on repeated tenant-impacting failures.
Retention: config per-tenant retention_days drives deletion workflow; deletion writes tombstone record to audit ledger (immutable).
Security: artifacts at rest encrypted with tenant KMS key when provided; access to historical packages controlled by RBAC (read:reports role).
Edge cases: large export streaming (avoid memory blowups) via chunked ZIP creation; support resumable uploads for S3 multipart and SFTP streaming with backpressure.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Large customers produce packages >100GB causing timeouts. Mitigation: chunked uploads, multipart S3, and streaming ZIPs; add size-estimation step and optional 'snapshot-only' mode.
Risk: Missing residency mapping results in incorrect region delivery. Mitigation: validate residency at job creation and require an explicit confirmation for ambiguous mappings.
Risk: Delivery failures lead to data exfil attempts via retries. Mitigation: rate-limit retries and enforce destination allowlist per tenant.
Risk: Legal requires chain-of-custody proof. Mitigation: include time-stamped, signed manifests and retain audit ledger entries for required retention window.
